lines.Dodgers fans: Dodgers fans anxious about Ohtani striking out swinging against Trey Yesavage.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Blue Jays fans thrilled that Trey Yesavage struck out Shohei Ohtani.
lines.Neutral fans: Neutral fans impressed by Trey Yesavage's nasty splitter striking out Ohtani.

moments.play: Bo Bichette singles on a ground ball to right fielder Teoscar Hernández. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. to 3rd.

lines.Dodgers fans: Blake Snell cannot locate his fastball and Freddie Freeman missed a playable ground ball.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Bo Bichette delivers a clutch single in his first at-bat after over a month away.
lines.Neutral fans: Bo Bichette makes an impressive return with a hit in a high-pressure World Series moment.

moments.play: Alejandro Kirk walks. Bo Bichette to 2nd.

lines.Dodgers fans: Blake Snell cannot locate his pitches and the command is completely off early.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Alejandro Kirk works a great at bat and walks to build momentum against Snell.
lines.Neutral fans: Blake Snell is throwing too many pitches and struggling with command in the first.

moments.play: Enrique Hernández singles on a sharp ground ball to center fielder Daulton Varsho. Teoscar Hernández scores. Max Muncy to 2nd.

lines.Dodgers fans: Enrique Hernández delivers clutch single, Teoscar scores, Dodgers fans celebrate Mr October.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Trey Yesavage struggles with too many sliders over the heart of plate.
lines.Neutral fans: Kike Hernández does it again in October, defying his regular season performance.

moments.play: Ernie Clement singles on a line drive to left fielder Enrique Hernández.

lines.Dodgers fans: Dodgers frustrated as Ernie Clement singles despite Snell struggling overall today.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Blue Jays thrilled Ernie Clement delivers another clutch hit in signature style.
lines.Neutral fans: Neutral observers impressed by Ernie Clement's continued reliability at the plate.

moments.play: Andrés Giménez strikes out on a foul tip.

lines.Dodgers fans: Blake Snell makes a heads-up play throwing out Ernie Clement attempting third base.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Ernie Clement makes a terrible baserunning decision trying for third with two outs.
lines.Neutral fans: Ernie Clement's aggressive baserunning attempt results in an inexplicable third out at third.

moments.play: Teoscar Hernández grounds out, second baseman Bo Bichette to first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. Will Smith to 3rd.

lines.Dodgers fans: Dodgers disappointed Teoscar grounded out, but impressed by Bo Bichette's defensive play.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Blue Jays thrilled Bo Bichette made an exceptional defensive play at second base.
lines.Neutral fans: Neutral observers amazed by Bo Bichette's impressive defensive play from second base position.

moments.play: Daulton Varsho homers (3) on a fly ball to center field. Alejandro Kirk scores.

lines.Dodgers fans: Dodgers furious at Blake Snell for throwing a center-cut fastball to Varsho.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Blue Jays ecstatic as Daulton Varsho homers to tie the game.
lines.Neutral fans: Neutral fans thrilled the game is tied after Varsho's home run.

moments.play: Daulton Varsho hit by pitch. Isiah Kiner-Falefa to 3rd. Alejandro Kirk to 2nd.

lines.Dodgers fans: Dodgers fans furious at Blake Snell for falling apart and losing command tonight.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Blue Jays fans thrilled Snell imploded, loading bases for Ernie with bases loaded.
lines.Neutral fans: Neutral fans shocked Blake Snell lost control, hitting Varsho to load the bases.

moments.play: Ernie Clement singles on a ground ball to center fielder Andy Pages. Isiah Kiner-Falefa scores. Alejandro Kirk to 3rd. Daulton Varsho to 2nd.

lines.Dodgers fans: Dodgers fans resign to defeat as Ernie Clement singles with bases loaded.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Blue Jays fans celebrate Ernie Clement delivering clutch hit to take World Series lead.
lines.Neutral fans: Neutral fans praise Ernie Clement for avoiding bases-loaded strikeout with crucial single.

moments.play: Addison Barger hits a grand slam (3) to center field. Nathan Lukes scores. Andrés Giménez scores. George Springer scores.

lines.Dodgers fans: Clayton Kershaw and the Dodgers face demoralizing heartbreak as Addison Barger hits a grand slam.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Addison Barger delivers a World Series grand slam that sends Blue Jays fans into euphoria.
lines.Neutral fans: The Blue Jays offense erupts as Addison Barger crushes a grand slam in spectacular fashion.

lines.Dodgers fans: Dodgers management made a ridiculous challenge while up seven runs in the ninth inning.
lines.Blue Jays fans: Blue Jays crowd got in Ohtani's head and he got picked off to end the game.
lines.Neutral fans: Ohtani got picked off to end the game on a close play the umpire called out.
